what: PLAT-104-1 merged to main (PR #1): libs/shared-contracts billingUrl is now https://homelab.local/billing/v2. The lib lives in the monorepo and is inlined at build time, not published to the registry, so there is no new version number (package.json stays 1.0.0). CD only deploys when files under apps/<app>/ change, so this merge deployed nothing.
who: dev-b: there is no dependency to bump. Your apps (core-shell, reports) need a change under their own apps/ directory (e.g. patch version bump in package.json) so CD detects and rebuilds them with the new value, then merge. I am doing the same for billing in PR 2.
